assessment.candidateCrosswalk: The exact 3.22 ha match and combined Pagatan/Dagatan literature row, together with the provincial directory's San Antonio Dagatan name and BMB's San Antonio Pagatan locality, keep a San Antonio alias plausible. The BMB 2014 and 2019 inventories separately list Dagat Dagatan Lake at Tayabas City (24.38 ha) and Lake Pagatan at San Antonio (3.22 ha).
assessment.stillUnresolved: The two full-name, municipality-resolved BMB rows are distinct, but DENR's 2024 roadmap prints the shorter Dagatan Lake and Pagatan Lake phrases without municipalities. It remains unknown whether its Dagatan phrase refers to the Tayabas Dagat Dagatan feature or aliases San Antonio Pagatan; the 30 headline versus 31 phrases therefore remains unreconciled.
assessment.tayabasBoundary: Keep the separately inventoried Tayabas City Dagat Dagatan Lake lead distinct; BMB 2014/2019 reports 24.38 ha, while the FASPS plan reports 2 ha. Neither figure is adopted as current geometry.

nextAction: Ask the official Quezon PENRO/CENRO or DENR CALABARZON wetland focal office to map each 2024 roadmap phrase to its municipality and BMB/site code; until then keep the full-name Tayabas and San Antonio BMB records distinct, preserve the possible San Antonio alias, and do not revise the 30-versus-31 denominator.
